sources.quote: lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI announced a $2 input and $10 output rate for the Grok-2-1212 API model family, but does not identify grok-2-latest or address cache pricing.

sources.quote: Cached tokens are billed at the cached prompt token price, which is substantially lower than the regular prompt token price. The exact rates vary by model — check the Pricing page for current prices.
sources.supports: xAI currently documents distinct cached-token rates that vary by model, but this page does not state the historical Grok-2 cache rate or when it applied.

notes: The official announcement supports the recorded base input/output rates for Grok-2-1212, but does not establish that grok-2-latest had those rates or show whether its cache rates changed on June 17, 2025. Internet Archive CDX requests for x.ai and docs.x.ai returned 503, so no snapshot pair was available to date or bracket the change.
